hook_text: The wind, the Sun and a river. None of them will ever run out. Can they keep our lights on?
clip_script: Jeffreys Bay: giant turbines whoosh in the sea wind. Wind spins the blades, the blades spin a generator. Electricity, no smoke! Northern Cape: rows of solar panels turning sunshine straight into electricity. Mirrors can even make steam from sunlight. Gariep Dam: water rushes through the wall and spins turbines. Renewable! But the wind drops, the Sun sets, droughts come. So we use a mix.
visual_style: Whiteboard triptych of a wind turbine, a solar farm and a dam, each with arrows to a generator and a light bulb, with a moon over the solar panel.
mood: Fresh and hopeful, like a breezy morning.
pacing: Wind, Sun, water, then the honest catch.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and spot solar panels on roofs near your home.
